svg.text: How each guide moves through review
One writer, eleven cold editors in a fixed order, two script gates, two human decisions, and the files that carry memory between guides
flags it and the other stays
rounds in all, every one of
LINE AND FIGURES: then how it is said
checks run on the revised draft
SERIES: does it agree with the other eleven?
every editor, rounds, verdict, open findings
Each editor returns SATISFIED or NOT SATISFIED with up to ten quoted findings, ranked HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW. SATISFIED means no HIGH and at most two MEDIUM.
The writer revises and re-sends, for at most three rounds. If the limit is reached, the summary says so beside the verdict, and the open findings go to the author.
Nothing enforces the order except the writer's instructions and the files each stage leaves behind. The gate is the only check that is code.
